links.comparator_used: In vitro (retrospective) model validation alone, with the model's in vitro screening decisions used as the reference for the live CDS
links.outcome: Coding errors and discrepancies detected in the CDS before clinical activation, and fidelity of in vivo CDS decisions to the in vitro model
links.effect: Silent pilot processed 18,335 patient encounters; raw agreement 95.5% (CI 95.2%-95.9%), kappa 87.6% (CI 86.7%-88.6%); several small coding errors found in CDS components and additional coding errors found in the fidelity analysis, all corrected
links.tradeoff: Required a 2-month silent pilot before activation; no other costs reported
links.quote: Our structured framework for the in vitro to in vivo translation of our predictive model uncovered ways to improve performance in vivo and the validity of risk assessment decisions.

design_hint: silent-mode pilot with technical component and fidelity analysis before go-live
